prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final furnished dormitory/cell interior concept mockup for an existing hand-painted 2D old Chinese factory/prison game.
Input images: Image1 is the user's MASTER LAYOUT REFERENCE (blurred crop from the approved campus concept). Image2 is the ACTUAL GAME STYLE and CHARACTER SCALE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Generate a NEW crisp production-oriented concept applying the master layout to the current game. Do not reproduce the blurred pixels or game HUD.
Camera and composition: ONE full furnished dormitory scene, orthographic slightly elevated TOP-DOWN game projection exactly like the actual game. All architectural edges and floor grid are screen-horizontal or vertical, not an isometric diamond or 3D dollhouse. Complete room and all four corners visible with a narrow paved walkway on the RIGHT and a little of the adjacent prison building roofs above/below for context. The usable interior is a shallow rectangular room approximately560world units wide and300world units deep. Keep the right/east-side entrance at the lower-right part of the right wall like the actual screenshot. No south-centre entrance. Main scene should be large, with minimal border; no inset diagrams, no labels, no explanatory text.
Art direction: match the current game's crisp hand-painted outlines, soft daylight, restrained warm-grey/olive palette and chibi character style. Old austere dormitory/prison materials: dark muted green-blue iron bed frames, ochre wooden lower bunk, off-white bed linen, blue-grey painted steel storage, warm grey/olive matte cement floor tiles, warm beige plaster and dark grey low wall skirt. Local modest wear at corners, hinges and wet fixtures; calm readable large surfaces with very sparse grime. Walls retain the existing modest beige stone/concrete coping and grey brick/plaster character; tidy joins but no clinic-like blue steel perimeter, aqua glazed wainscot or luxury housing.
Exact layout adapted from Image1:
1. UPPER LEFT: ONE genuine two-tier iron bunk bed whose long sleeping direction runs HORIZONTALLY LEFT-TO-RIGHT on screen. Two horizontally aligned sleeping levels are visibly stacked in a COMMON four-post frame, not two separate single beds and not a vertical bed. White pillow at the LEFT end of each level. Upper bunk has off-white bedding with a restrained ochre/khaki blanket band; lower bunk shows a worn ochre/brown blanket or wooden bed surface with a neatly folded pale sheet. Slim iron ladder on the right side. The bed takes about200–220world units of room width and is visibly long enough for the character. Show both levels clearly with the approved game projection, no forced perspective.
2. UPPER MIDDLE immediately to the RIGHT of the bunk: a slim BLUE-GREY personal storage locker, around60–70world units wide, simple two stacked compartments or two narrow doors, muted worn paint, vents and small latch. It stands against the north wall with a clear accessible front. No wide hospital drawer chest.
3. UPPER RIGHT between locker and far-right counter: ONE separate small off-white ceramic toilet with compact cistern and dark bowl opening, facing downward toward the room centre. Old clean-enough institutional ceramic, not a giant sink-toilet combo. Modest footprint, not higher than the character.
4. FAR RIGHT against the east wall ABOVE the existing side entrance: one narrow north-south aligned wash/preparation counter, dark aged steel or concrete base, light enamel top, small tap and rectangular wash basin at its lower section, a modest upper shelf with one cup/toothbrush and a tiny folded towel. Its right-side vertical arrangement must closely echo the master crop. One small warm wall lamp above it. Keep a clear approach to the toilet and basin.
5. LOWER LEFT: ONE small low square stool or closed linen box with a grey/off-white fabric cushion, like the small rectangular furnishing in the master reference. Low and modest, not a second bed. Add only a small neatly folded cloth on it.
6. CENTRAL and LOWER MIDDLE: maintain a clear accessible walking patch linking bed, locker, wash fixtures and the RIGHT side doorway. Put ONE familiar spiky-black-haired orange-uniform chibi PLAYER there near the east entrance, full body visible. Same character identity and scale as Image2: height84world units relative to the room's300depth, no rescaling to a tiny person. He is fully clothed. No guards, other occupants or selection circle.
7. RIGHT entrance: slim dark steel side-door jambs integrated into the existing prison wall, open clear passage to the paved corridor. Door opening has no floating crossbar, invisible step, heavy swinging leaves or furniture across it.
Keep the approved campus layout compact and coherent while fitting the actual shallow room: bed, locker and wash fixtures form a north/west/right furniture band, cushion stool sits at lower-left, middle remains walkable. Avoid unnecessary extra furniture: no desk, television, sofa, plant, large laundry basket, extra storage banks, artwork or rugs. One small cup and cloth are enough.
Important: The large "寝室" word in Image1 is a MAP CONCEPT LABEL, not physical decor. DO NOT put any room-name text or sign on the FLOOR. No HUD, FPS, warning overlays, wayfinding path or buttons. No hospital cross, modern apartment polish, photographic rendering, exaggerated noise, massive thick walls, vertical sleeping orientation, mismatched object scale or comic distorted perspective.
Finish as one clear believable gameplay-view final dormitory furnishing concept, readable at normal game zoom.
